answers.hosting: GitHub Pages, from this repo, on the custom domain claudinite.com — the existing deploy-pages.yml is an artifact-flow Pages deploy of site/, so the full release-on-push → Pages pipeline applies.
answers.publish_set: site/ is the published root: index.html, privacy.html, the assets/ directory (style.css, main.js, analytics.js, favicon.svg) and data/promoted.js. site/README.md documents the site for maintainers and is not served.
